source.name: Vodafone UK: Rugby Sponsorships & Partnerships
source.quote: Vodafone is the Principal Partner of men’s, women’s, and pathway (U20s and U18s) rugby in Wales, alongside front-of-shirt and back-of-shorts sponsorship.
source.note: Undated live partnerships page, opened 2026-09-30; confirms the current deal (WRU/Vodafone announced the multi-year extension in June 2023). The Vodafone wordmark and swoosh fill the centre chest of the official 2026/27 replica home front product photos (WRU store / rugby-heaven.com). The page also claims back-of-shorts rights, but the official 2026/27 replica home shorts product photos (rugby-heaven.com, all five views) show only the WRU crest and Macron branding — no Vodafone mark on the replica shorts; match-worn shorts not verified.

source.name: Welsh Rugby Union: Go.Compare backs Wales teams
source.quote: which will see its logo feature on the back of all of the WRU’s senior international and pathway teams in both the men’s and the women’s game with immediate effect
source.note: WRU announcement of the multi-year deal (page undated; July 2023 from the URL and the 'debut August 5th' sentence). Still current: the GO.COMPARE wordmark sits across the upper back in the official 2026/27 replica home back product photos (WRU store / rugby-heaven.com), and Go Compare remains in the 'Principal Partners' footer of the WRU's August 2026 kit-launch page.

source.name: Welsh Rugby Union: WRU unveils new home and alternate kits inspired by the land and legend of Wales
source.quote: The Welsh Rugby Union (WRU) and official kit supplier Macron have today unveiled the new home and alternate kits for the senior national teams
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. Page undated; August 2026 from the URL and its launch-day wording (kits on sale 6 August).

summary: Vodafone across the front and Go.Compare across the upper back of the red Macron home shirt, both under multi-year deals from 2023 confirmed as current by Vodafone's live partnerships page and the official 2026/27 replica product photos. Sleeves, lower back and the white shorts carry only tonal dragon artwork, the WRU crest and Macron branding — checked against all eleven official replica product photos of the shirt and shorts.
